summary.text: Louis Ruiz is a Democratic member of the Kansas House of Representatives representing District 31, and the Legislature's member page lists service in the House since 2005.

paragraphs.text: Louis Ruiz is listed as a member of the Education Committee and the Federal and State Affairs Committee.
The Legislature lists Louis Ruiz's occupation as Retired; Lucent.
The page names Marthel Parsons-Ruiz as Louis Ruiz's spouse.
